steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Welcome!

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Oh, you're...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: One set meal to go, please.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Here's the money.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Okay, exact change... No, wait a second!

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: What are you doing here? And your clothes... Did another experiment go wrong?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: No, it went well.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Just a bit of an accident at the end. No problem at all.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: You call that 'no problem'... I'll never understand you outsiders.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Also, didn't I say I'd deliver meals for you and Felipe? If you just come here like this...
The eyes in the small tavern converge upon the two, most of them not exactly friendly.
All around, conversations cut themselves off as the other customers take in the presence of the unfamiliar Ægir face.
The silence is soon replaced by excited whispers.

steps.name: Curious Customer
steps.text: Is that the one? The outsider here for some sort of 'cooperation.'

steps.name: Curious Customer
steps.text: Looks like a normal guy to me.

steps.name: Cautious Customer
steps.text: Shh, he's Ægir.

steps.name: Curious Customer
steps.text: Didn't the Inquisition agree to allow their return?

steps.name: Cautious Customer
steps.text: You can't trust everything you hear.

steps.name: Cautious Customer
steps.text: I don't want to get dragged into it if he gets arrested or something.

steps.name: Cautious Customer
steps.text: Things may have gotten better in recent years, but don't tell me you forgot how it was a decade ago, when the Inquisition was dragging people off on the regular.

steps.name: Curious Customer
steps.text: Of course I haven't. I was young then, but I remember being interrogated for a long time. I was almost taken away.

steps.name: Curious Customer
steps.text: You're right, better safe than sorry. He's Ægir, after all...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Noisy.
The Ægir casually picks up the cup from the table.
Then he lets it slip from his fingers, and it shatters on the ground with a bang.
The tavern instantly quiets down.

steps.name: Curious Customer
steps.text: He didn't hear us, did he?

steps.name: Cautious Customer
steps.text: Shh, who knows? Best keep our mouths shut.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I'll pay for the cup.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: ...That's not what I'm concerned about.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Yeah, don't worry about it.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: I should be saying that... er, don't worry about it.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: They're not bad people. It's just that...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Not a problem. Just a matter of getting used to it.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: But isn't it hard to take?

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: I heard from the mayor that you and your friends are here to help us.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: We're the ones asking for help, yet we're treating you like this...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Huh? You misunderstand me.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I don't care what other people think of me. What I meant was that the rest of you Iberians have to get used to it.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: The Inquisition has made its choice.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: A window has opened. Ægirs who were once forced to leave are now returning. There will only be more of us in the future.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: If you've decided to accept our help, then you need to get used to seeing us on the streets.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: ...Is that why you go out for a walk in town every day?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I'm not just walking, I'm measuring. I need to know how wide the roads are.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I was surprised to find that time seems to have stopped for decades here. Many things need to be fixed or replaced.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: It's the same thing... walking on the streets like you own the place. All the customers have been talking about you.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Doesn't matter to me.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Ha... alright, as long as you're okay with it.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: So how are preparations going with you and Felipe?

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Are you planning a surprise? Felipe said it was a celebration... but I don't remember any festive dates this time of year.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I'm just helping out. Felipe has a good idea; we just need to hammer out the details.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: You'll know more soon enough.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: You're not about to do anything crazy, are you?

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: I heard there were festivals that last for days, with flowers and cheering crowds everyday, and fireworks in broad daylight... I can't even imagine.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: We haven't had anything like that for a long time.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: It's not too late.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Felipe wants everyone to be able to participate, like in the Iberia of yore.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Is he still reading those books? The Adventures of Captain Alfonso, The Pirate King and the Golden Kingdom... he hasn't outgrown them?

spans.text: Is he still reading those books?
The Pirate King and the Golden Kingdom

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Nothing wrong with that.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Iberia in its Golden Age may have been arrogant, but at least there was something to be proud of, compared to the shambled state it's in today.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Felipe has a knack for working with machines. He really should go out into the world and broaden his horizons, if the opportunity presents itself.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Go out and see the world...

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: That would be really nice.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Here's your set meal.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: And this one's for Felipe.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: How much?

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Treat it as a token of appreciation on behalf of the others. To tell the truth, I'm kind of looking forward to the surprise you and Felipe are planning.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: I hope it'll be like in the books.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Okay? What do you mean—

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: He's gone.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Weird guy...

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: Hold it, Felipe.

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: Didn't you hear us?

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: ...Did you need something?

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: I'm in a hurry. If you don't have anything important—

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: Where do you think you're going?

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: You're not fiddling around with that Ægir again, are you?

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: That's none of your business.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Besides, Mr. Thorns is here by invitation. You should show some respect.

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: Respect is one thing, keeping your distance is another.

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: Besides, he won't even tell you his real name, just a code name. Who's to say he didn't use to be a bandit or something?

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Mr. Thorns said he's an employee of Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: He's an Iberian expatriate, forced to leave after certain events...

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: Rhodes what? Never heard of it.

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: And what events, exactly? How do we know for sure he's not the same as those crazy Ægir?

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: Maybe he's one that the Inquisition is after, just good at hiding things—

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: Er—

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: This is all baseless accusation, pure speculation!

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Don't any of you remember that tomorrow is—

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: Tomorrow is what?

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: ...You'll find out tomorrow.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: I trust the Inquisition's judgment. And I know that Mr. Thorns isn't like that.

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: ...Alright, Felipe, I guess I went too far. That Ægir—the one who calls himself Thorns—may be useful.

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: As for tomorrow, I'm not sure what you're planning... but we'll be waiting.

steps.name: Tense Townsfolk
steps.text: Just remember that we're really worried about you. You should open your eyes and stay away from the Ægir!

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Was that my fault?
People like you may be a minority among the Iberians.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Mr. Thorns?!

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: When did you...?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: From 'fiddling around with that Ægir again.'

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Here, this is from Martín's Tavern.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Ah, thank you...

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Wait a second! I'm so sorry about just now.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: They aren't bad people. Please don't take it personally.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: They're just concerned... We don't see a lot of outsiders here.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: My head hurts.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I don't like being apologized to over and over again.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: S-Sorry!
The Ægir who has returned to his homeland in a manner he never expected sighs.
The past is buried deep in his heart. He can overlook a lot of things, but there is something different about this place and the people who live here.
That is why he stands here now, as an Ægir.
Because he has the ability to do so. Following his heart, he came back to the place that he never thought he would come back to.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: There's nothing to apologize for.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Have you finished calibrating the... what was it, 'Automatic Perpetual Sugar Sprayer'?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: It fell quite a bit short of 'perpetual' in the last test.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Ah, yes! I was just about to tell you. I think I'm about to make some real progress in efficiency and endurance!

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: It's all thanks to that manuscript from Weedy you brought.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Thank her yourself if you have the chance.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: I will!

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Along with the concoction that you prepared, everyone will be so surprised tomorrow!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Oh, by the way, I want to make some improvements to what I brewed up.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: ...Have you ever seen the 'Midday Flame'?

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: M-Mr. Thorns!

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: *cough*, *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: A-Are you okay?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Just got the ratios wrong.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Things don't look fine to me...

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Look, your hair got burnt!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Hm? Oh...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Just shave it off.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: What are you doing with the knife? Wait! Don't cut it like that—!

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: For heaven's sake, at least let me do it for you!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Alright then.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Er, haha, it's nothing...

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Alright, that should do it.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: You should keep your distance, to be safe.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Are your experiments always so dangerous?

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: They invited you here, but then put you out in the middle of nowhere, without proper facilities...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: It's fine, this is a good place.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I have all the basics here. Anything more complex probably needs an application anyway.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Application?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: To the Inquisition.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Years ago, they arrested a lot of people, confiscating everything that the Islanders brought. Technology that has been lost to modern-day Iberia may still be found within the Inquisition.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: And now it's time to put it to use.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: There are no Ægir left in this town.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: There used to be some, years ago. I heard that when my parents were young, everyone was treated the same way, whether they were Liberi or Ægir.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Until the Penal Battalion arrived.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: ...Yes, until they arrived.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Many people were taken, mostly Ægir, but also people of other races who were close to them.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: The rest of the Ægir left one by one. People say they left of their own accord, but...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: But you don't agree.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: I... I don't know. I wasn't there.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: You seem to know a lot about these things.
Thorns knew a lot about these things.
The fate of the Ægir in this country was sealed the moment Iberia realized the threat from the ocean, when the Inquisition began using force to deal with its tentacles stretching out from the sea.
They had breathing room in some places; in others, they were not so lucky.
This town happened to be one of the 'others.'

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: The fear of suppression has always hung over Iberia. Whether they left of their own accord or were forced to leave doesn't matter in the end.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: A worse fate awaited those who stayed than those who went into the barrenlands, or returned to the ocean.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: ...Did you leave because of that too?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: So... why did you come back now?

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Even I can see that life out there is good.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: A strange question.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Do I need a reason?

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Amiable Priest
steps.text: Have you decided where you want to go?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Anywhere.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Maybe outside, away from this country.

steps.name: Amiable Priest
steps.text: Your eyes are calm, my child.

steps.name: Amiable Priest
steps.text: You're the only one who didn't try to persuade me to leave together.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: You won't leave.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: ...You're not innocent.

steps.name: Amiable Priest
steps.text: Ha, perhaps.

steps.name: Amiable Priest
steps.text: Go, child. Your will has always been strong. Follow it.

steps.name: Amiable Priest
steps.text: Never stop thinking. We have the right to follow our thoughts, no matter where they lead us.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: I'll remember that.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Farewell, teacher.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Don't overthink it.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Iberia provided an opportunity, and the other Ægir and I accepted its offer. There was something in it for both of us.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: ...I knew a fool who believed that Iberia would change.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: But I don't care how it changes; I just want to do what I want to do.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: You always seem so calm.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: The Ægir who left, the ones who should have been our brethren...

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Will they come back someday?

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Maybe, if you wish it.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Aren't you doing all this in preparation for that day?

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: What are you doing, Felipe?!

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Why have you blocked the roads? What's with these strange machines?

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: Stop this absurdity at once and go home!

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Of course I know what day it is, Uncle Pablo.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Once, friends from a faraway land took our hands, and together we built the Golden Age.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: And this was the day that our hands first came together.

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: What are you babbling about...?

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Am I really babbling, Uncle Pablo?

steps.name: Mayor
steps.text: T-That was ages ago...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: People don't bring it up anymore. Many don't even dare to.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: But the Iberians should have remembered.

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Today is a day to remember.

steps.name: Skeptical Townsfolk
steps.text: A day to remember?

steps.name: Skeptical Townsfolk
steps.text: I've never heard of it...

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: You're too young to.

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: We used to celebrate it when I was little. There were people frolicking in the square, day and night. We would call each other brothers.

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: The Ægir built new things. Ships that traveled on dry land, automatic fireworks, lighthouses that changed color on their own...

steps.name: Skeptical Townsfolk
steps.text: Then why have I never heard about any of this?

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: ...We stopped celebrating them.

steps.name: Old Townsfolk
steps.text: After... all those terrible things.

steps.name: Skeptical Townsfolk
steps.text: So... they're telling the truth?

steps.name: Skeptical Townsfolk
steps.text: We used to celebrate this day?

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Of course we did!

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Let's do it, Mr. Thorns!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Okay.
A Liberi and an Ægir stand side-by-side in the crowd.
Tears gather in the eyes of the older townsfolk at the sight of it. Memories have faded with time and wordless oppression. Have they seen a scene like this in the past?
All eyes are on the Ægir as he lights the fuse.
They were happier times, better times.

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: ...Fireworks?

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: Fireworks in bright daylight...

steps.name: Friendly Woman
steps.text: The books were telling the truth...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Maybe they'll write about this, someday.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: You mean they'll write about me, just like they write about Captain Alfonso? Haha, I find that hard to believe.

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: Oh, Mr. Thorns, Mr. Thorns!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Felipe
steps.text: You've got powder from the fireworks on your face!

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Thorns
steps.text: Consider it part of the celebration.
